method: Read 734–774 with quoted statement boundaries and narrator asides distinguished. Teach transferable rhetorical and work-related expressions without endorsing speculation about motives.
phrases: afforded the opportunity
given the chance to do something, formally
获准有机会……；被给予机会……
Each applicant was afforded the opportunity to ask questions.
每位申请者都获得了提问的机会。
Afford means provide here, not have enough money. Passive afforded + opportunity + to-infinitive is formal; the source's mitigate their conduct remains awkward and separate.
non-statement
a statement criticized for conveying little useful information
被批评为言之无物的声明
The team wanted a clear answer, not another non-statement.
团队想要明确答复，而不是又一份言之无物的声明。
Evaluative non- formation, not necessarily literal silence or absence of a document. As much of a ... as ... can be intensifies the narrator's criticism.
Office of Student Conduct
a university office dealing with student behavior and conduct procedures
学生行为事务办公室
The fictional university referred the matter to its Office of Student Conduct.
那所虚构大学把此事转交给学生行为事务办公室。
Office is an organizational unit, not just a room. This contextual gloss does not establish the exact powers, procedures or current official title of Cornell's office.
diligently
with sustained care and effort
认真尽责地；勤勉地
She checked the figures diligently before sending the report.
她发送报告前认真核查了数字。
Manner adverb modifies reviewing. In the quoted statement it is the institution's description of its own work, not an independent assessment.
whatever that means
an aside expressing uncertainty or skepticism about a vague phrase
也不知道那到底是什么意思（常带质疑）
They promised a flexible solution, whatever that means.
他们承诺提供“灵活的方案”，也不知道那到底是什么意思。
Usually skeptical, and can sound dismissive; not a neutral request for a definition in every setting. Here the narrator interrupts reported institutional wording.
What the fuck does that mean
an emphatic, vulgar question expressing confusion or disbelief
那他妈到底是什么意思？（粗俗、强烈质疑）
The dialogue uses 'What the fuck does that mean?' to express angry confusion.
对话用“What the fuck does that mean?”表达愤怒和困惑。

Receptive register note: fuck is an intensifier inside a question, not a sexual verb. Neutral alternatives are What does that mean? or Could you explain what that means? Avoid this wording in polite professional requests.
individual and collective goals
aims pursued personally and aims shared by a group
个人目标与集体目标
The workshop helped us connect our individual and collective goals.
工作坊帮助我们把个人目标与集体目标联系起来。
Individual contrasts each person's aims with shared aims. Formal institutional language; a statement of goals is not proof of achievements.
Cornelians
members of the Cornell community, in this address
康奈尔大学社群成员（此处的称呼）
The speech addressed Cornelians at the campus gathering.
演讲在校园集会上向康奈尔社群成员致意。
A community-specific name in the source, not the English word corn or the whole local population. Do not infer that every addressee is a current student.
restful
allowing relaxation and recovery from activity
让人放松休息的；安宁的
I hope you have a restful weekend.
希望你度过一个能好好休息的周末。
Rest + -ful gives a rest-providing quality. The source is a holiday wish, not evidence about recipients' actual circumstances.
loved ones
people who are emotionally close and dear to someone
亲人；所爱的人
She spent the holiday with loved ones.
她和亲人一起度过了假期。
Not limited to romantic partners; includes family and other close people. Natural collocations include contact loved ones and time with loved ones.
Interim president
a person temporarily serving as president
临时校长；代理校长（此处为大学职务）
The interim president led the university while a successor was selected.
遴选继任者期间，代理校长负责领导大学。
Interim means temporary pending another arrangement. This is the quoted historical title, not a claim about who currently holds office.
reverses out of
moves backward out of a place, typically in a vehicle
倒车驶出；倒退出
She checks the mirror before she reverses out of the driveway.
她把车倒出车道前会先看后视镜。
Same physical sense as back out of in Unit 2. The source sarcastically recalls the earlier parking incident; probably should is advice/evaluation, not proof of a new event.
intriguing
arousing interest or curiosity, here with a hint of suspicion
引人注意的；耐人寻味的
The timing of the announcement is intriguing.
这则公告发布的时机耐人寻味。
Interesting because it invites questions; not proof of wrongdoing. To me marks the narrator's reaction to timing.
speculating
forming possible explanations without enough evidence to be certain
猜测；推测
I'm only speculating about why the meeting was moved.
我只是在猜测为什么会议改期了。
Here evidence-limited conjecture, not financial speculation. Just limits the claim's certainty; it does not turn a suggested motive into a fact.
festivities
celebrations and enjoyable activities associated with an occasion
庆祝活动；节庆活动
The town's winter festivities begin on Friday.
镇上的冬季庆祝活动周五开始。
Plural event noun, not the holiday date alone. Source uses the public's busy schedule as part of a speculative media-attention explanation.
vagueness
lack of clear detail or precision
含糊；不明确
The vagueness of the instructions caused confusion.
说明含糊不清，引发了困惑。
Vague + -ness forms a noun. The narrator's view that vague wording was intentional remains a view; lack of detail does not establish a motive.
extensive
covering a wide range or large scope
范围广泛的；涉及面广的
The handbook contains extensive guidance on the process.
手册对这一流程提供了广泛的说明。
Scope/coverage sense here, not expensive. Pretty means quite in pretty extensive; the speaker announces simplification rather than a complete legal account.
segments: Completes the seven-name list from 733 rather than a new list. Track names as printed; Julia/Jillio/Giglio variants elsewhere and Scott K/Kay/Kretschmar forms are not authenticated merely by list position.

Formal given-a-chance construction now has support. Who were starts a relative fragment referring back to some suspended people; mitigate their conduct is awkward because essays may mitigate consequences or assessment, not undo conduct. Retain that scope ambiguity rather than silently replace the object.

As much of a non-statement as a statement can be is a maximizing comparison: the narrator judges the statement nearly devoid of substance while still formally a statement. The evaluative noun now has support; this criticism is not an independent finding about adequacy.

Institutional office role and careful-effort adverb now have explicit cards. Has been reviewing presents ongoing activity up to the statement; regarding means about. These are the institution's reported descriptions, not our certification of diligence.

Taken actions means acted, and addressing concerns means dealing with concerns. Including what addressing appears to interleave a skeptical interruption with the list; preserve the boundary issue rather than identify what as part of a clean institutional quote.

The skeptical aside is now distinguished from resumed institutional reporting. Temporarily suspending the organization and suspensions for students are two described targets; a number of means several, not a precise count or a final expulsion.

In the quoted statement, challenged how we see each other means unsettled mutual perceptions, not eyesight. How we see each other and think about our community are coordinated perspectives; for many limits who experiences difficulty. The abstraction is reported rhetoric, not a new factual claim.
phrase:10:what the fuck does that mean

Profane intensification of a rhetorical demand for clarification now has a register-labeled receptive card and polite alternatives. It is the narrator's reaction, not wording attributed to the institutional statement.

As it has to others omits risen: the community has supposedly risen to other challenges. Will rise and continue to pursue coordinate future actions; individual/collective contrasts personal and shared aims. This is confidence expressed in a quote, not verified success.

Community addressee, rest-providing adjective and emotionally close people now have explicit support. Wish someone a restful break is a conventional closing wish; loved ones is broader than partners alone.
Historical temporary university-leadership title now has explicit support. It signs the quoted letter; do not update the title or current personnel from the execution date.
Temporary title and historical at-the-time reference are now understood. Before he becomes is unfinished; the intended later role may be inferable but is not supplied as a verified completion.

Reverse movement from a parking place is now explicitly taught and linked to the earlier account. Probably should be a bit more careful is sarcastic evaluation; no new collision, intent or date is asserted.
Intriguing now conveys curiosity/suspicion while to me makes it personal evaluation. I have to say introduces a candid comment, not a literal compulsion or proof that timing was strategic.

Students off campus means away from the grounds during the break; block his car recalls the prior parking protest. Perhaps qualifies the proposed inability to protest and once more invokes repetition, not evidence that avoiding protest motivated the release.
Look draws attention and just explicitly limits the statement to conjecture. The new card prevents the proposed timing motive from being heard as established knowledge.

Holiday celebrations, strong doubt and careful searching are all supported. The narrator doubts that reporters are searching official pages during the holiday; the embedded action is doubted, not reported as actually observed. To look for gives the hypothetical search purpose.

Vague wording now has a noun card; can't help but think expresses an insistent impression. Repeated the timing and the vagueness clarifies the two perceived features, but deliberate intent remains the narrator's speculative judgment.

Wide scope now has support and pretty is degree quite, not appearance. Because explains the decision to simplify in 772–773; it does not make the following overview a complete or currently authoritative legal explanation.
